jobs.title: Senior AI Solutions Builder
jobs.description: About the Role We're looking for a Senior AI Solutions Builder to join our Product team. In this role, you will design, build, and ship AI-powered solutions that enhance productivity and drive measurable business value across the organization. You will operate at the intersection of AI, data, pricing and business - owning the end-to-end development of agents, copilots, and workflow automations that directly inform decisions and eliminate manual work. jobs.title: Senior Collections & AR Specialist
jobs.description: Cloudinary is the foundational technology powering images and videos across the internet. Our platform enables companies around the world to manage, optimize, and deliver visual media at scale through powerful APIs and integrations. Visual media is the electricity of today’s digital world - and Cloudinary is the infrastructure that keeps it flowing seamlessly. About the Role We are looking for an experienced, driven, and detail-oriented Senior Collections & AR Specialist to join Cloudinary’s CFO Office. As part of the Billing team, you will report to the Billing Director and take ownership of Cloudinary’s global collections operations. You will work directly with customers and collaborate closely with Finance, Sales, Customer Success, Account Management, and other cross-functional teams to ensure timely payments, resolve complex billing and payment issues, and identify opportunities to improve processes and drive operational efficiencies to support the company’s cash flow performance. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys building strong customer relationships, solving problems, and continuously improving processes in a fast-paced global SaaS environment.

jobs.title: Senior Edge Compute & Backend Engineer
jobs.description: As a Senior Edge Compute & Backend Engineer, you will join Cloudinary’s Delivery team, collaborating closely with both frontend and backend specialists. Your role involves driving feature development, maintaining core codebases, and managing our extensive multi-CDN delivery platform. Our team oversees the global-scale delivery of Cloudinary customer assets and the underlying software and infrastructure. This encompasses our edge platform and CDN infrastructure designed for high-performance delivery, alongside the backend services that power them. We are trusted by leading global brands to provide high-fidelity media via flexible transformations, ensuring minimal latency and optimized bandwidth.

jobs.title: Senior FP&A Manager (Contract)
jobs.description: Cloudinary is the Image and Video API platform trusted by millions of developers and over 10,000 companies worldwide. Our powerful tools fuel websites to be faster, richer in user engagement, and breakthrough creativity. With a growing suite of products that support everything from developer efficiency to brand storytelling, Cloudinary is becoming the visual layer of the web. Cloudinary has a globally distributed team across North America, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific, united by a shared commitment to building smart, scalable technology and a culture rooted in humility, curiosity, and collaboration. At Cloudinary, we celebrate Life & Work. We believe in healthy growth, working with purpose, and creating meaningful value. If you’re looking for a place where your voice matters and your work truly makes an impact, this may be the opportunity for you. Cloudinary is seeking a highly analytical and strategic Senior FP&A Manager to join the CFO Office. Reporting to the VP of Finance, FP&A, you will lead company-wide financial planning, forecasting, cash flow management, and performance analysis. As a key business partner to Finance and executive leadership, you will drive financial visibility, operational discipline, and data-driven decision-making while helping build the processes, rigor, and scalability required for Cloudinary’s journey toward becoming a public company. This is a 6-month contract position, requiring a minimum of 2 days at our San Jose Office.

jobs.title: Staff Backend Engineer - Moderation
jobs.description: Who We Are Our team is building a new product within Cloudinary, focused on large scale visual moderation. It is a fast moving, high impact effort that is already attracting interest from major customers. We operate like a small startup inside Cloudinary, which means: Full independence in technical and product decisions Freedom to build things the way we want The backing and stability of a well established, successful company Strong people first culture with genuinely great teammates We own the full development lifecycle, from deciding what to build to how we build, ship, and operate it. The team is very small, highly focused, and fully hands on. Why This Role Is Different You will work on a backend system where scale, cost, and correctness all matter at the same time. You will have real architectural ownership, direct customer impact, and the freedom to move fast without heavy process. Few roles offer this combination inside a mature company. What You Will Do Own the Server Side Design, build, and evolve the server side of a moderation platform operating at scale, including: High throughput async pipelines Large volumes of images and videos Multi tenant systems Cost sensitive ML workloads Agentic moderation workflows and AI-driven decision systems Ship Fast, Ship Smart Deliver value iteratively with a clear focus on customer and business impact. Move quickly without losing sight of long term architecture and operational quality. Set the Technical Foundation Make architectural decisions that scale over time. Use agentic development and code generation to accelerate delivery, while keeping engineering judgment, technical accountability, and code ownership firmly in human hands. Elevate Quality and Standards Build clean, modular, secure backend systems that are meant to live and evolve. Establish good engineering practices around testing, observability, reliability, and maintainability. Drive Innovation and Practicality Explore new ideas and approaches, but always ground them in real world constraints like latency, cost, and operational complexity. Who We Are Looking For Experienced Backend Engineer 10+ years backend experience owning and delivering production systems. Strong hands on coding skills and confidence working deep in the backend stack. Languages and frameworks do not slow you down. We use Python. Cloud Native Strong experience building and operating cloud based systems, preferably on AWS. Hands on experience with distributed systems, async processing, queues, workflows, and production monitoring. Independent, Collaborative, and Comfortable with Ambiguity You thrive in low-process environments and communicate clearly and take ownership of outcomes, not just implementation. You can step into new domains, work through messy problems, and make fast progress while collaborating effectively with engineers, PMs, and stakeholders across the company. A Great Teammate You value clear communication, trust, humor, and helping build a strong and supportive team culture.

jobs.title: Staff Backend Engineer- Agent Experience
jobs.description: Cloudinary is the media experience platform trusted by millions of developers and thousands of companies — from fast-growing startups to the world's largest brands — to power the images and video behind their digital experiences. Something fundamental is changing about who uses that platform. Increasingly, the "developer" calling our APIs isn't a person — it's an agent: an LLM, a coding assistant, an autonomous pipeline acting on a human's behalf. Our Agent Experience (AX) R&D team exists to make Cloudinary the default media layer those agents run on. Our guiding principle is simple: make agentic workflows work flawlessly with no friction. We're a small, fast, high-ownership team, and we're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to make Cloudinary work for agents — both by building new agent-facing infrastructure and by reshaping our existing platform for a world where the caller is a machine. Some of this is greenfield. Much of it is taking APIs, auth, and SDKs and making them ergonomic, legible, and reliable for agents. It’s a problem the whole industry is still figuring out. You’ll help define what great API design looks like when the caller is not a human developer, but an agent acting on their behalf.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer (AI & Innovation)
jobs.description: The Mission Cybersecurity moves at the speed of code, but security management still moves at the speed of humans. Critical insights are often trapped in siloed scan results, complex attack paths, or the tribal knowledge of senior researchers. These processes don’t scale, they can’t be automated, and they leave organizations vulnerable in the gaps between tools. CYE’s AI & Innovation team is changing that. You’ll build production-grade AI agents and modular AI capabilities that live atop the Cye Platform. You aren’t just building features; you are building an AI-native operating system for cyber risk. Every complex security workflow—from data acquisition to autonomous mitigation—will become legible to code, runnable by anyone, and composable into larger defense strategies. Who We Are 🛡️ The Product: CYE is the leader in data-driven cyber risk management. The Cye Platform uses advanced mathematical models and world-class security research to help organizations move from reactive patching to proactive risk orchestration. 🚀 The AI & Innovation Team: We are the architects of CYE’s intelligence layer. Our team is composed of security researchers and engineers who treat LLMs as a new reasoning primitive for cybersecurity. We are responsible for the core AI infrastructure and agentic workflows that allow the CYE Platform to think, prioritize, and act at scale. 📈 Momentum: Backed by global powerhouses like EQT, CYE secures many of the world’s most complex enterprises. As the threat landscape evolves through AI, our team ensures that the defense stays ahead.
